title: Suresh Sallay admitted to National Hospital
summary: Former State Intelligence Service (SIS) Director, Suresh Sallay, has been admitted to the Emergency Treatment Unit (ETU) of the National Hospital of Sri Lanka.

title: Govt. to revive 25 stalled health projects at cost of Rs. 76Bn
summary: The Government has commenced a programme to revive and complete 25 major health infrastructure projects that were abandoned midway, with an estimated investment of Rs. 76 billion needed to finish the developments.

title: Wife arrested over stabbing of husband in Horana
summary: A woman has been arrested in connection with the fatal stabbing of her husband following a domestic dispute in the Arambakanda area of the Horana Police Division during the early hours of Sunday (June 7).

title: Heavy rain, strong winds forecast across several areas
summary: The Department of Meteorology has forecast continued showers and thunderstorms across several parts of the country, with heavy rainfall and strong winds expected in some areas.

title: South Korea nominates Han Seong-sook as country’s first female prime minister in two decades
summary: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung has ⁠chosen Han Seong-sook, the country’s ⁠minister for small and midsize ‌businesses and startups, to be prime minister, the presidential office said on Sunday.

title: Western Province DS offices recognised for President’s fund drive
summary: Divisional Secretariat offices that recorded the highest level of performance under the President’s Fund decentralisation programme in 2025 were honoured at a special recognition ceremony held yesterday (06) at the Miloda Auditorium in Colombo.

title: Huge crowds throng Madrid streets for Pope’s open-air mass
summary: More than a million people lined the streets of Madrid on Sunday as Pope Leo XIV held an open-air mass in the Spanish capital, the Vatican said.

title: Major food supplier fined for selling expired products
summary: A leading food supplier in Nugegoda has been fined Rs. 75,000 and ordered to destroy a stock of food items after pleading guilty to multiple consumer protection violations.

title: Private buses to slash services by 50% over fare dispute
summary: Commuters across Sri Lanka could face major transport disruptions from tomorrow as private bus operators have decided to cut services by 50 percent, citing mounting losses, rising fuel costs, and the government’s failure to grant fare relief.

title: CAASL chief named Asia-Pacific Aviation Security chair
summary: Sri Lanka has secured a key leadership role in regional aviation security, with the Director General and Chief Executive Officer of Civil Aviation, Captain Daminda Rambukwella, being appointed Chairman of the Asia-Pacific Aviation Security Programme (CASP-AP) for 2026/2027.

title: Suresh Sallay’s treatment under PTA is deeply troubling - Namal Rajapaksa
summary: Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna (SLPP) National Organizer Namal Rajapaksa said that concerns raised before court by the legal counsel of Major General (Retd.) Suresh Sallay regarding his treatment in custody, was deeply troubling and asked why activists who were against the PTA maintained such a silence.

title: Suresh Salley being used as a scapegoat, says wife following CID visit
summary: Speaking to the media for the first time outside the Criminal Investigation Department (CID), Manory Salley, the wife of former Major General Suresh Salley, defended her husband, insisting that he is innocent and is being unfairly used as a ’’scapegoat.’’
